text:
erin-plat: customer bug: billed twice when they closed stream during a tool_call.
mike-ops: paste session id + logs
erin-plat: sess: s-9x7. Steps: stream -> ~110 tokens emitted, tool_call dispatched, client drop, router retried fallback -> emitted ~22 tokens, tool returned later -> tool tokens 58. Invoice shows 110+22+58.
luisa-dx: are tool tokens currently charged at dispatch or on return?
erin-plat: at dispatch. stream tokens as emitted.
josh-console: console timeline only shows final charges. provisional events buried.
mike-ops: root causes: (1) toolcall charged too early, (2) router replay can duplicate prefix emissions, (3) UI lacks provisional state.
luisa-dx: quick mitigation: mark toolcall charges provisional, finalize on tool_outcome. add toolcall_id propagated across retries so we can dedupe.
erin-plat: ledger sketch:
- on_stream_emit => provisional stream entry
- on_tool_dispatch(tool_id) => provisional tool entry tagged tool_id
- on_tool_outcome(tool_id, actual_tokens) => finalize/replace provisional
- on_ttl => mark orphaned
mike-ops: need prefix_owner=(route_id,epoch) and prefix_hash to map overlapping emits.
josh-console: UX: show provisional badge + orphaned filter + "related events" inspector to group stream emits and tool provisional/final.
luisa-dx: telemetry events: charge.provisional, charge.finalized, charge.orphaned, session.replay. SQL to detect orphans:
SELECT count(*) FROM ledger_events e WHERE e.event_type='provisional_tool' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ledger_events f WHERE f.toolcall_id=e.toolcall_id AND f.event_type='finalize_tool') AND e.created_at > now() - interval '7 days';
erin-plat: rollout plan: feature flag in router (accounting=provisional_v1) + console flag. Canary 1% sessions -> monitor orphan_rate -> widen.
mike-ops: also need migration to mark old pending provisional entries as orphaned pre-cutoff.
luisa-dx: will add unit tests for disconnect+replay and integration TTLs.
billing-bot: ticket RB-3001 created and linked.
erin-plat: thanks all, will open PRs and post links here.
